scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/backend" "cd apps/web && flutter run -d web-server --web-port=5173 --dart-define=API_URL=http://localhost:4000/api"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix apps/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/backend && cd apps/web && flutter test --platform chrome
